description: List restaurants, optionally filtered by cuisine. Sorted by rating descending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of restaurant objects.

description: Retrieve a full restaurant object by restid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full restaurant object.

description: List all menu items for a restaurant, optionally filtered by category.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of menu item objects.

description: Retrieve a full menu item by miid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full menu item object.

description: Add a new menu item to a restaurant.

available.description: Whether the item is currently available.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new menu item object.

description: Update one or more fields on an existing menu item. Only supplied fields are changed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated menu item object.

description: List orders, optionally filtered by status and/or customer. Sorted by placed_at descending.

status.description: Optional status filter (placed, confirmed, preparing, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of order summaries.

description: Retrieve a full order object by oid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full order object.

description: Place a new order at a restaurant. Enforces min_order and item availability.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new order summary.

description: Cancel an order that is still in 'placed' or 'confirmed' status.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the cancelled order summary.

description: Restaurant confirms a placed order. Transitions status placed -> confirmed.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated order summary.

description: Kitchen starts preparing the order. Transitions status confirmed -> preparing.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated order summary.

description: Driver picks up an order. Transitions status preparing -> out_for_delivery.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated order summary.

description: Driver delivers an order. Transitions status out_for_delivery -> delivered and sets delivered_at.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated order summary.

description: Search restaurants by keyword across name and cuisine. Sorted by rating desc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of matching restaurant objects.

description: Aggregate stats: restaurant count, menu size, orders by status, and non-cancelled revenue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {restaurants, menu_items, orders, by_status, revenue}.
